name: SEYMOUR
source:
A high-ranking warlock who made a deal with the demon king Nairazmat, bestowing him with a board range of magical power.

Where his magic falters, he makes up for with his unrelenting charisma, assuming he can be bothered.

He likes lemon tea and thin stew.
He hates working hard and close-minded people.

[From in-game profile]
